bio.text: Helene Neville is an independent candidate for North Dakota's at-large U.S. House seat in 2026; she sought the Democratic-NPL endorsement, finished third, and filed as an independent.
She is a Philadelphia native who now lives in Jamestown, a former travel nurse, and a public health consultant who has worked in eight states.
According to the North Dakota Monitor, she ran nearly 17,000 miles on foot across the country to promote healthy living, is the author of multiple books, and has not sought elected office before.

sources.title: First-time candidate running as independent for US House in North Dakota
